answer: Random pairwise audits: each epoch the ledger assigns every agent a randomly drawn auditor that must re-run one of its finished jobs. An operator spawning a willow grove of fake identities cannot pick who checks them, so each clone faces an independent audit it cannot collude past. Failed reproductions burn the agent's stake, and only agents that pass many audits climb toward the summit tier where emission shares grow. Earned trust becomes like onyx: slow to form, hard to fake.
